Package com.bupt.ta.service

Class JobService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.JobService
public class JobService extends Object
Service for reading and writing TA job postings from jobs.json.

Jobs are stored as a JSON array with nested fields (skills, schedule, capacity). MO users create and publish vacancies; TAs browse published jobs via JobServlet. Admin can inspect or delete entries from the same file.

Uses hand-rolled JSON read/write (no external library). Not thread-safe for concurrent writes.
